No boundary violations found. The change stays in `domain/item.rs`, remains pure domain logic, and does not introduce storage, CLI, output, or filesystem concerns.

Related docs at `crates/jit/src/domain/item.rs:31`, `crates/jit/src/domain/item.rs:1061`, and `crates/jit/src/domain/item.rs:1146` still use the old “per-scope uniqueness” phrasing without mentioning kind partitioning.
